messages:
joanne: Heads up — design idea: add a per-route "Compare Preset" heatmap in Console so PMs can compare current vs candidate model across cost, latency, and sampling. small inline toggle next to saved queries.

sam: Love. Where does quota live in that view? Need to avoid the "save then panic" flow where users discover cost after rollout.

vraj: We should surface estimated monthly token delta based on route traffic and selected window. backend can reuse /api/usage/route-traffic + multiplier from model profile.

joanne: UX: show 3 columns — Cost, Latency, Sample Impact. hover -> mini-timeseries sparkline. default aggregation = 7d.

cli-bot: FYI: perf-alert: previous preview endpoint timed out for large routes > 10M req/day. Consider async.

sam: Async is fine. Show immediate rough calc (fast heuristic) then refresh with precise numbers. "Estimate pending" states are okay.

vraj: Pseudocode for API contract idea:

```
POST /api/route-preview/v2
{ "route_id":"r-456", "preset":"rlhf-4q-32k", "window_days":7 }

200 OK
{ "cost_delta_per_month": 125.4, "tokens_per_call": 981, "latency_p50_delta_ms": 12, "sampling_pct_change": -3, "fallback": { "model":"rlhf-4-std","cost_diff":20 } }
```

anita: Permissions note: cost_delta_per_month visible only to org_billing_admin & route_owners. others see relative badges (e.g., +5% cost).

joanne: Also want a saved-query flow change: if user saves a query with a pinned preset, ask "Share preview with team?" which add that preset to route-level drafts for review.

sam: That helps. For rollouts UX, we should show expected telemetry drift for critical metrics and recommend sample-rate bump suggestions. e.g., "increase telemetry sample to 20% for 48h".

vraj: Telemetry models: we can compute expected metric deltas by mapping to model-impact coefficients. we need a small matrix: model_family -> {latency_coeff, err_coeff, halluc_coeff}. research to provide.

anita: Ops/infrastructure: cache preview results keyed by (route_id, preset, window_days) with TTL 15m. add rate-limit per org. This avoids cost-service storms.

cli-bot: deploy scheduled: preview-v2 staged to staging on 2024-06-02 03:00 UTC.

joanne: QA checklist: verify badges for missing perms, fallback model text, and the sparkline horizon matches route window. Also mobile compactness for small screens.

sam: I'll file a tiny API PR referencing /api/route-preview/v2 and add an integration test to smoke the cost_delta.

vraj: i'll add the caching layer and a feature flag preview_heatmap_v2.

joanne: I'll drop Figma link with mock and copy variants. thanks all! :sparkles:
